name: Front-End Kit
description: Sample listing used to build and test the site before the real catalog arrives; it is excluded from the production build. This front-end kit groups the parts that are replaced together on the 2018–2024 Toyota Camry: one pair of front sway bar links and one pair of outer tie rod ends, under one kit SKU at a lower price than buying them separately. Kit contents and prices are placeholders until the owner confirms them with the suppliers. In the box: two sway bar links and two outer tie rod ends.
